words.label: Headline tile
words.note: Where the headline and the join sit among the tiles on a wide screen. On a phone the headline and the join always come first, then the tiles.

start.label: On the left
start.note: The headline and the join down the left, the tiles to their right. The default.

end.label: On the right
end.note: The tiles on the left, the headline and the join down the right. Use it to swap sides with a photograph further down the page.

top.label: Across the top
top.note: The headline and the join side by side across the top, the tiles in a band under them.

cells.label: Tile style
cells.note: How the tiles are set apart from each other.

ruled.label: Ruled
ruled.note: One block divided by thin lines, like a printed grid. The default.

spaced.label: Spaced
spaced.note: Separate cards with a gap between them, in your brand's card style.

motion.label: Movement
motion.note: Whether this section moves as the visitor reaches it. Nothing moves for a visitor who has asked their device for less motion, whichever you pick.

default.label: Still
default.note: Nothing moves. The section is simply there when the visitor reaches it, which is the default.

moving.label: Moves
moving.note: The tiles ease in one after another as the page opens, after the headline and the join, and a member lifts a little when pointed at. It needs the platform's behaviour library; where that is not served the section is simply still.
